title: Design System: Empowered Delivery — Final Homepage

label.purpose: Section index numbers, nav, CTA text, art notes, tool console rail.

shadows.name: hero-close-inset
shadows.purpose: Single closing hairline shadow on the hero scene.

shadows.name: hero-headline-text-shadow
shadows.purpose: Legibility for hero h1 over photography.

shadows.name: focus-ring-vermillion
shadows.purpose: Visible keyboard focus ring on the signal-reveal button.

motion.name: link-hover-fade
motion.purpose: Nav and text link hover fade.

motion.name: image-drift-reduced-motion-guard
motion.purpose: Slow image drift only runs when motion is allowed; reduced motion disables it entirely.

components.name: Section Index Label
components.description: Scene wayfinding label, e.g. '01 / THE MACHINE'. Appears at the top of every scene.
components.css: .final-section-index { color: var(--red); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Action Button
components.description: Bordered, unfilled text button with a vermillion trailing glyph.
components.css: .final-action-button { background:transparent; border:1px solid currentColor; color:inherit; cursor:pointer; font:inherit; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.12em; padding:14px 18px; text-transform:uppercase; } .final-action-button span { color:var(--red); margin-left:22px; }

components.name: Signal Reveal Button
components.description: 320px circular instrument that reveals a representative relationship caption on click; the page's one hidden-content interaction, used exactly once.
components.css: .final-signal { align-items:center; background:#22282a; border:0; border-radius:50%; color:var(--cream); cursor:pointer; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; height:320px; justify-content:center; padding:40px; width:320px; } .final-signal:focus-visible { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--red); } .signal-ring { border:1px solid #7398a5; border-radius:50%; inset:22px; position:absolute; }

components.name: Diagnostic Console
components.description: Two-column instrument: 300px selector rail plus a readout panel with a flat vermillion signal-strength bar.
components.css: .final-tool-console { border-top:1px solid var(--line); display:grid; grid-template-columns:300px 1fr; } .readout-bar { background:#313536; height:4px; margin-top:34px; } .readout-bar i { background:var(--red); display:block; height:100%; width:78%; }

components.name: Lens Orbit Diagram
components.description: Concentric circle diagram visualizing system + behaviour + culture; the system's one relationship visualization, petrol-toned.
components.css: .final-lens-orbit { border:1px solid #78929a; border-radius:50%; height:370px; position:relative; width:370px; } .final-lens-orbit:before,.final-lens-orbit:after { border:1px solid #5b7379; border-radius:50%; content:''; inset:48px; position:absolute; } .final-lens-orbit:after { inset:110px; }

narrative.northStar: Reports show the surface. The system is underneath.
narrative.overview: The Empowered Delivery final homepage tells one continuous story across fourteen full-bleed scenes, alternating dark ink/charcoal machine scenes with warm cream paper scenes. Oversized Georgia display type and treated photographic machinery carry the narrative instead of cards, icons, or dashboard chrome. Vermillion marks tension, action, and diagnostic emphasis; petrol/steel blue marks systemic relationships. The page reads as a field guide, not a marketing grid.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed scene composition, no shared container width
Single vermillion accent; petrol blue reserved for systems/relationships
Georgia display serif for meaning, Inter for structure and function
Flat surfaces, no card elevation, photography as narrative machinery
Section index labels as the wayfinding spine across all fourteen scenes

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Vermillion is the only accent used for action, tension, and emphasis anywhere in the page. Petrol blue is borrowed only for the systems/relationships motif and never competes with vermillion on the same scene.

rules.name: The Georgia-for-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Only headline text and the equation/theory statements use Georgia. Structural, navigational, or numeric content stays in Inter.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. The only permitted shadow is the hero's closing hairline and the hero headline's legibility text-shadow.

dos: Do keep every scene full-bleed with its own background field
Do reserve vermillion as the single accent for tension, action, and emphasis
Do pair Georgia display type with Inter functional type
Do treat photography as narrative machinery, not card decoration
Do use the section index label on every new scene
donts: Don't add drop-shadow card elevation or rounded card corners
Don't introduce a second color accent alongside vermillion
Don't repeat the signal-reveal interaction pattern elsewhere
Don't center content into a fixed-width column
